Name: Hiel the Bethelite
Summary: Hiel the Bethelite rebuilt Jericho in Ahab's days, laying its foundation at the cost of his firstborn Abiram and its gates at the cost of his youngest Segub, according to Joshua's curse.
KeyStory: Hiel rebuilds Jericho at the cost of his sons.
RelatedPeople: King Ahab; Abiram, Son of Hiel; Segub, Son of Hiel
LifeLesson: An old curse is not old news: Hiel paid for Jericho in his own sons.
